title: Deposition, production, and inspection.
bodyText: Rules 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 34(c), and 45 of the Hawaii rules of civil procedure shall apply to subpoenas issued under section 624D-3.
bodyHtml: [§624D-5]  Deposition, production, and inspection.  Rules 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 34(c), and 45 of the Hawaii rules of civil procedure shall apply to subpoenas issued under section 624D‑3. [L 2012, c 17, pt of §1]
